verdicts.reason: A: the headline and date are shrunk to a tiny size and sit in a thin strip at the top. The wind turbine, the hero image, is shrunk to a speck and placed in a row with the green, red and blue triangles, as if they were all icons of the same weight. The right half is mostly empty apart from stray lines. B: the headline is larger and readable, and it reads left to right as a banner should. But the turbine and the triangles are crammed into one overlapping cluster on the right, the turbine is barely visible, and there is a dead gap in the middle. B is less bad because its message can be read.
